query:
SELECT
                    file_a AS "file_a!",
                    file_b AS "file_b!",
                    CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS "co_edits!",
                    MAX(committed_at) AS "last_co_edit!"
                 FROM coupling_pair_events
                 WHERE project_id = $1
                 GROUP BY file_a, file_b
                 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(committed_at) DESC, file_a ASC, file_b ASC
                 LIMIT $2
